.@DelanoSquires just released an important book on the vanishing black family and how government programs are decreasing the number of children raised in homes with a married mother and father. Order your copy here: heritage.org/the-vanishing-b…

Video

Director for Heritage’s Center for Human Flourishing, @DelanoSquires, just released an important book about how government programs have decreased the number of children raised in homes with a married mother and father. Order your copy here: heritage.org/the-vanishing-b…

Our social programs often incentivize broken families!

“ When you look at social policy, either the child or the mom is the recipient and not the family.  By changing that goal, you’re going to change the outcomes.” - Martin Brown, Former Asst. Sec. of Health and Human Resources and Former Commissioner of Social Services, Virginia

Video

The connection between family structure and social outcomes is impossible to deny, so why is it that progressives apply an equity lens to every institution except the institution of marriage, and every structure except family structure?

@DelanoSquires nypost.com/2026/06/14/opinio…

Director for Heritage’s Center for Human Flourishing, @DelanoSquires, just released an important book about how government programs have decreased the number of children raised in homes with a married mother and father. Order your copy here: heritage.org/the-vanishing-b…

“Fathers are the backbone of families.” - James Jackson, Co-Founder of Rooted in Healing

Video

.@DelanoSquires is the author of the new book The Vanishing Black Family: How Welfare and Feminism Made Marriage Optional and Children Vulnerable. 

Learn more and order your copy here: heritage.org/the-vanishing-b…

“Many urban policymakers seem to take the unspoken position that when it comes to low-income families...it takes two for nature and only one for nurture. They treat men as the appendix of the family. Nice if you have one, but not particularly necessary.” - @DelanoSquires

Video

OUT NOW 👉 The Vanishing Black Family: How Welfare and Feminism Made Marriage Optional and Children Vulnerable by @DelanoSquires, Director of Heritage's Center for Human Flourishing. heritage.org/the-vanishing-b…
